title: Zombie Horizon
description: The Ultimate Hardcore City Survival Experience. Can you escape the concrete grave?
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c7e5bfaaccf8facd77d5a8f849741cb51cdda612_0.webp)

# WHAT IS ZOMBIE HORIZON?
Zombie Horizon is a high-fidelity, tactical survival simulation designed for those who find the vanilla apocalypse too easy. Set in the decaying, overgrown ruins of The Lost Cities, this pack blends realistic gunplay, advanced medical systems, and a terrifyingly intelligent undead horde.

Every bullet is a choice. Every wound is a story. In Zombie Horizon, you aren't just playing Minecraft—you are fighting for your life in a world that wants you dead.

# MAIN FEATURES

## 🧟 THE EVOLVED ZOMBIE THREAT
The undead are no longer mindless. Powered by **Zombie Awareness**, they track your scent, hear your footsteps, and follow the trail of your blood. With **Hordes** and **Enhanced Celestials**, you’ll face massive waves and terrifying blood moons that will test your fortifications to the limit.

![Zombies](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/40e177b16b94dd021b81c2fe1a6607b3d51951a8.webp)

## 🔫 TACTICAL WEAPONRY (TACZ)
Experience the gold standard of Minecraft firearms. Featuring **Timeless and Classics Zero (TACZ)**, you have access to a massive arsenal of guns with realistic 3D models, smooth handling animations, and deep customization. Master the recoil or become another casualty of the ruins.

## 🏙️ BREATHTAKING URBAN EXPLORATION
Roam through a hauntingly beautiful apocalypse. **The Lost Cities** are reimagined with **Terralith** generation and **Dynamic Trees**, creating a lush, vertical world where nature is slowly swallowing the skyscrapers. Every building is a loot-filled treasure chest—and a potential deathtrap.

## 🛡️ FORTIFY & CONQUER
Protect your loot with **SecurityCraft** and **Trapcraft**. Set up cameras, laser tripwires, and reinforced doors to keep the horde and other players out. Use tactical gear to scout the ruins and plan your next move. Build castles, fortresses, walls and don't forget to use spikes for extra protection.

## ⚠️ IMPORTANT — BEFORE YOU PLAY
When creating a new world, remember to enable the generation of **The Lost Cities**.

## 🖥️ QUICK SETUP
- Loader: Forge 1.20.1
- Recommended RAM: 8–10 GB
- Singleplayer & Multiplayer supported

## ❓ FAQ
**Do I need to download anything manually?**  
No. Everything is included. Just install the modpack through the Modrinth App and you're ready to go.  

**Can I play in singleplayer?**  
Yes. Zombie Horizon is fully playable in singleplayer and multiplayer.  

**The world generated but there are no cities. What do I do?**  
When creating a new world, make sure the generation of cities is enabled in the world settings. Without it, **The Lost Cities** will not generate.  

**How difficult is this modpack?**  
Very difficult. Zombies track your scent, hear your footsteps, and follow your blood trail. Expect to die often, especially at night or during blood moons.  

**What are blood moons?**  
Blood moons are special events triggered by **Enhanced Celestials** where massive zombie hordes attack. Fortify your base before nightfall.  

**Do I need a powerful PC?**  
A mid-range PC is enough. We recommend at least 8–10 GB of RAM allocated to Minecraft for the best experience.  

**Is PvP supported?**  
The modpack does not enforce PvP, but **SecurityCraft** and **MineTraps** let you protect your base from other players on multiplayer servers.
